TransitionKind.description: What a program-scene change looks like (protocol 1.81, ADR-0128).

oneOf.description: The new scene fades in over the old one.

Shared sources slide to their new boxes, new ones fade in (the collection
glide, ADR-0100), leaving ones fade out.
The new scene slides in over the old one from an edge.
The new scene pushes the old one out.

A media file plays over the change; the scenes switch at its cut point
(protocol 1.89, ADR-0140). Its duration is the file's play range.

`kind` and `duration_ms` replace the collection's for this change; absent ones keep
it. With kind `move`, `duration_ms` replaces the glide's duration and every
per-source override for this change.
